description: A dark, painterly TV studio stage with two silhouetted men in suits seen from behind at side podiums. Behind them is a large wall of glowing blue answer panels, and a crowd sits in the shadowed audience. In the centre a tall lit monitor on a pedestal shows a glowing swirl of orbital rings and a bright green-blue globe. Spotlights hang from a metal truss overhead. No legible text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.
